metadata.description: shostako's fork of nogu66/md-prompt, with VBA painting

plugins.name: md-prompt
plugins.description: Paints Markdown onto the prompt box as you type: syntax-highlighted code blocks, inline code, bold, italic, lists, tables, quotes, links and headings. Paint only, your text is never changed. This fork adds VBA: ```vba highlighting, and Sub … End Sub typed without a fence painted as VBA.
